mentions.name: Latin textbook scan-to-Org converter
mentions.description: This workflow extracts poorly aligned, pixelated PDF image scans of century-old Latin textbooks from the Internet Archive and transforms them into Org mode documents while preserving important typographic details, nicely formatted tables, and semantic document metadata.
mentions.problem: Century-old Latin textbooks on the Internet Archive exist only as poorly aligned, pixelated PDF image scans.
mentions.source_excerpt: I want to show how I liberate poorly aligned, pixelated PDF image scans of century-old Latin textbooks from the Internet Archive and transform them into glorious Org mode documents while preserving important typographic details, nicely formatted tables, and some semantic document metadata.

evidence.value: I want to show how I liberate poorly aligned, pixelated PDF image scans of century-old Latin textbooks from the Internet Archive and transform them into glorious Org mode documents while preserving important typographic details, nicely formatted tables, and some semantic document metadata.
